provenance.original: TSA will process amendments to the RSSP by request of a regulated entity.  TSA estimates it will receive one and a half amendments (specifically, the expected probability of 10% of applicants will make amendments per year).  TSA assumes the full-loaded hourly wage rate of $97.20 for airport operator security coordinators.  TSA estimates each requested amendment will place an 8-hour burden on a regulated entity, for an average annual hour burden of 12 hours and an average annual hour burden cost of $1166.40.  Table 2 summarizes these estimates.
